name: Seekho (सीखो)
tagline: Turns any educational video into six personalised formats, including dyslexia-friendly and multilingual ones.
problem: One video format does not suit every learner.
solution: A seven-agent pipeline analyses the video and generates quizzes, flashcards, diagrams, explanations and examples adapted to level, language and accessibility needs.
demo_moment: Team-described: paste a video and switch to dyslexia mode.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[Peraton] Beats Headphones + Peraton swag” among 112 submissions.

lessons: Personalisation is visible when you can toggle formats live.
